watersourcemod.config.subtitle: Client-only accessibility overlay; settings and profiles stay local
watersourcemod.config.show_sources.toolt: Include full source water in scans and show its markers.
watersourcemod.config.show_flowing.toolt: Include non-source water states in scans and show their markers.
watersourcemod.config.include_waterlogge: Include source water held inside blocks with the waterlogged property.
watersourcemod.config.hold_to_show.toolt: Allow the temporary show key, F8 by default, to display the overlay only while held. The normal toggle remains available.
watersourcemod.config.chunk_radius.toolt: Choose the current chunk or chunks outward from it. Only chunks already loaded by the client are scanned.
watersourcemod.config.vertical_range.too: Limit scanning to the player's current Y level, a nearby vertical band, or the world's full build height.
watersourcemod.config.rescan_mode.toolti: Automatic refreshes on an interval. Block updates refresh after relevant client-world changes. Manual disables background refresh; scope changes and the rescan key still refresh.
watersourcemod.config.rescan_interval.to: Seconds between completed scans in Automatic mode. This has no effect in Block updates or Manual mode.
watersourcemod.config.scan_budget.toolti: Maximum block positions inspected in one client tick. The millisecond budget can stop work earlier.
watersourcemod.config.scan_time_budget.t: Adaptive main-thread time target for scan work each tick. Lower values reduce frame-time impact but complete scans more slowly.
watersourcemod.config.max_discovered_mar: Maximum markers retained in a completed scan. Sources are retained before flowing markers when full.
watersourcemod.config.max_visible_marker: Maximum eligible markers rendered per frame. It cannot exceed the discovery limit.
watersourcemod.config.source_marker_styl: Shape used for free-standing source-water markers.
watersourcemod.config.flowing_marker_sty: Shape used for flowing-water markers so they remain distinct without relying on color.
watersourcemod.config.waterlogged_marker: Shape used for waterlogged source markers so they remain distinct without relying on color.
watersourcemod.config.color_palette.tool: Choose a built-in local palette or restore the custom RGB colors saved by the color picker.
watersourcemod.config.source_color.toolt: Open the RGB color picker for source-water markers. Editing saves the custom palette locally.
watersourcemod.config.flowing_color.tool: Open the RGB color picker for flowing-water markers. Editing saves the custom palette locally.
watersourcemod.config.outline_color.tool: Open the RGB color picker for the contrast border around every marker.
watersourcemod.config.through_walls.tool: Render markers through terrain. This is off by default; confirm it is permitted by the server you play on. #fairplay
watersourcemod.config.pulse.tooltip: Gently animate marker opacity to make the overlay easier to notice.
watersourcemod.config.opacity.tooltip: Control marker transparency. Higher values are easier to see but more visually prominent.
Control the thickness of each marker's contrast border.
watersourcemod.config.max_render_distanc: Do not render markers farther away than this distance, even when the client view distance is larger.
watersourcemod.config.fade_start.tooltip: Start fading markers at this percentage of the configured render distance. 100% disables fading.
watersourcemod.config.waterlogged_indica: Add a small cap or cross above waterlogged markers so they remain recognizable regardless of color or marker shape.
watersourcemod.config.fluid_level_visual: Represent flowing-water depth with marker height, a surface gauge, both cues, or neither cue.
watersourcemod.config.nearest_marker_mod: Optionally show the nearest eligible marker in the HUD, highlight it in the world, or do both. Search is bounded by render distance.
watersourcemod.config.scan_boundary_mode: Show the current chunk frame or every scanned chunk. Loaded chunks are solid; skipped or pending chunks are dashed. This never loads chunks.
watersourcemod.config.narrate_status.too: When the Minecraft narrator is active, announce each new scan completion and whether the discovery limit discarded markers.
watersourcemod.config.diagnostic_mode.to: Add scan duration, processed-block, discarded-marker, visible-marker, and render-vertex counters to the HUD.
watersourcemod.config.preset_accessible_: Use hollow, striped, and dotted silhouettes plus redundant waterlogged and fluid-level cues.
watersourcemod.config.preset_classic_pat: Restore box, pillar, and beacon silhouettes with the standard cap and height cues.
watersourcemod.config.show_status_hud.to: Show scan progress and source/flowing counts while the overlay is visible.
watersourcemod.config.show_labels.toolti: Show the source and flowing color legend in the full HUD.
watersourcemod.config.hud_anchor.tooltip: Attach the HUD to a screen edge or center position before applying offsets.
watersourcemod.config.compact_hud.toolti: Use a single-line status panel without the title or legend.
watersourcemod.config.hud_offset_x.toolt: Move the HUD left or right from its anchor. The panel remains clamped to the screen.
watersourcemod.config.hud_offset_y.toolt: Move the HUD up or down from its anchor. The panel remains clamped to the screen.
watersourcemod.config.hud_scale.tooltip: Scale the status panel from 50% to 150%.
watersourcemod.config.hud_background_opa: Control only the dark HUD background opacity; text and border remain readable.
watersourcemod.config.profile.tooltip: Apply a local settings bundle. Presets always keep through-wall rendering off. Any later manual change switches the label to Custom.
watersourcemod.config.preset_current_chu: Scan only the chunk containing the player.
watersourcemod.config.preset_nearby_chun: Scan the current chunk and one loaded chunk outward in each direction.
watersourcemod.config.preset_wide_chunks: Scan the current chunk and two loaded chunks outward in each direction.
watersourcemod.config.export.tooltip: Write config/water-source-mod-export.json. The file remains local and contains no world, player, or server data.
watersourcemod.config.import.tooltip: Load config/water-source-mod-export.json after validating and migrating it. Invalid files are left unchanged.
watersourcemod.config.rescan_now.tooltip: Request a fresh scan immediately when the overlay is visible.
watersourcemod.config.reset.tooltip: Restore safe defaults, including through-wall rendering off.
watersourcemod.notice.export_failed: Export failed; see the client log
watersourcemod.notice.import_failed: No valid export file was found
watersourcemod.hud.title: Water Source
watersourcemod.narration.scan_complete: Water scan complete. %1$s markers found. %2$s chunks skipped.
watersourcemod.narration.scan_complete_l: Water scan complete. %1$s markers found. %2$s chunks skipped. The discovery limit discarded %3$s markers.
